name: Dead Apostle Ancestor
description: (Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:time)(Tag:vampiric)Race - You are a true Dead Apostle Ancestor with immense physical and magical power, rewinding your own time to heal whenever you are injured while you hold blood. You wield your own Idea Blood, a Legendary Ability costing no ability slot, turn anyone who ingests your blood into a powerful vampire instantly, and all vampires and undead acknowledge you as the ultimate vampire class.
